name: insecure-file-mode
description: Practice-box helper: creates a caller-selected file with caller-selected content and an intentionally loose mode. Use distinct vars for each file finding.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${FILE_PATH:?FILE_PATH is required}"
: "${FILE_MODE:?FILE_MODE is required}"

install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$FILE_PATH")"
printf '%s\n' "${FILE_CONTENT-}" > "$FILE_PATH"
chmod -- "$FILE_MODE" "$FILE_PATH"
